data_description.device: Prefer a /dev/serial/by-id/… path so the port survives reboots.
data_description.baudrate: The thermostats use 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit by default.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the serial device server.
data_description.baudrate: With RFC 2217 Home Assistant sets the serial parameters on the server.

rtu_over_tcp.title: Serial device server (raw TCP)
rtu_over_tcp.description: Set the server to TCP server mode with 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit; Modbus RTU frames are passed through unchanged.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the serial device server.

modbus_tcp.title: Modbus TCP gateway
modbus_tcp.description: Set the gateway to convert Modbus TCP to Modbus RTU, with 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit on the serial side.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the gateway.

thermostats.title: Thermostats
thermostats.description: Enter the Modbus address of every thermostat on this bus. Other Modbus devices may share the bus as long as each device has its own address. The address is set on the thermostat: with it switched off, hold M and the clock key for 5 seconds, then press M until option C is shown. The default is 1.

data.skip_check: Add without checking that they respond

data_description.addresses: Separate with commas; ranges are allowed, e.g. 1, 2, 5-8.
data_description.skip_check: Use this when some thermostats are not powered yet.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the bus. Check the port or host and port.
error.no_response: No answer from thermostat(s) {addresses}. Check the addresses, wiring (A/B) and serial settings, or tick the option to add them anyway.
error.no_devices: Connected, but none of the configured thermostats answered.
error.not_thermostat: The device(s) at {addresses} answered, but don't look like PTB thermostats. Another kind of device on this bus may use that address.
error.address_in_use: Address(es) {addresses} are already used on this bus by {users}. Every device on a bus needs its own address.
error.link_conflict: This port or host is already used by another integration with different serial settings: {error}

data_description.addresses: Separate with commas; ranges are allowed, e.g. 1, 2, 5-8.
data_description.timeout: How long to wait for a thermostat to answer before asking again (up to 8 tries). On a bus shared with other integrations this is a minimum for the whole connection. Applied from Home Assistant 2026.10.
data_description.message_delay: Minimum pause between requests to the same thermostat. Does not slow down other devices on the bus.
data_description.auto_sync_clock: Set the thermostat clock from Home Assistant whenever it is more than 2 minutes off. Needed for the timer and schedule modes.

error.invalid_temp_range: The maximum must be above the minimum.
error.address_in_use: Address(es) {addresses} are already used on this bus by {users}. Every device on a bus needs its own address.

link_conflict.message: The bus is already used by another integration with different serial settings. Use the same settings everywhere. {error}

not_accepted.message: Thermostat {address} did not accept value {value} for register {register}. Set points must be 5–50 °C, and only the manual and timer modes are supported.

yaml_hub_shared.title: Modbus YAML hub on the same bus as {title}
yaml_hub_shared.description: The Modbus YAML hub(s) {hubs} open their own connection to the same port or host as {title}. Requests from both can collide on the RS485 bus and cause timeouts or wrong readings. Config-entry based integrations share one connection automatically; consider moving those devices to an integration set up from the UI, or using a separate bus or port.
